definitions.explanation: A government official appointed to reside in a foreign city to protect the interests and assist citizens of the appointing country. Operates from a consulate.

examples.japanese: {領事|りょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for a visa at the Japanese consulate.

examples.japanese: {総|そう}{領事|りょうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧コミュニティー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: An event was organized for the consul general to interact with the local Japanese community.

notes:
{領事|りょうじ} is a government official stationed in a foreign city to assist citizens of their home country and handle diplomatic matters.

KEY DISTINCTION:
- {領事|りょうじ}: the consul (the person)
- ⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧: the consulate (the building/office)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総|そう}{領事|りょうじ}: consul general (senior consul in a city)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{領事|りょうじ}: honorary consul
- {領事|りょうじ}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧: consular services
- {在|ざい}〜⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧: Japanese consulate in ~

CONTRAST WITH {大使|たいし}:
- {領事|りょうじ}: consul — handles practical matters (visas, passports, citizen assistance)
- ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧: ambassador — the top diplomatic representative in a country
- ⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧: consulate — often in major cities beyond the capital
- ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧: embassy — in the capital city
